roadmap.title: Opening and first bounty
roadmap.description: Play the Earth intro and the 9-Torg bounty. Pop Grunt eyes, kill Slumsley, stab Gene, juggle an enemy, talk to Globo, then watch the long countdown advert at home.

roadmap.title: Douglas and Krubis bounties
roadmap.description: Take Douglas before Krubis. Get Sweezy, then boss around the Moplets with Sweezy equipped, and get Gus.

roadmap.title: Giblets, Skrendel and Nipulon bounties
roadmap.description: Finish the three mid-game bounties. Pay the Applebee's bill, finish Globo's chain and keep Stan's item.

roadmap.title: Final bounty
roadmap.description: Pick up Lezduit, finish Garmantuous, and sacrifice a gun other than Kenny.

roadmap.title: Post-game cleanup
roadmap.description: Use Blorto's warp discs, find all Luglox chests and trading cards, fill the hunter forums and find the Human Haven hideout.

roadmap.title: High On Knife story
roadmap.description: Play Knifey's Package. Take the missable DLC choices and finish Mux.

roadmap.title: High On Knife cleanup
roadmap.description: Collect the packages, cards and landmarks and farm the weapon kill counters.

achievements.displayName: Fallout Doesn't Let You Do This
achievements.summary: Kill Slumsley, the kid who taunts you when you first enter the Blim City Slums.

steps.text: In the @loc{Blim City Slums} during the 9-Torg bounty, shoot @npc{Slumsley} when he appears and keep shooting until he dies.
You meet him only once. Do not let the ant guards ahead kill him first.

achievements.displayName: Bring A Knife to a Gun Fight
achievements.summary: Obtain Knifey.

steps.text: Play through the opening. Knifey joins you automatically.

achievements.summary: Defeat 9-Torg, the first bounty.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{9-Torg} in the first bounty. Use Knifey stabs to speed up the fight.

achievements.displayName: Don't Knife The Hand That Feeds
achievements.description: Take Knifey's advice and stab Gene in the gut.
achievements.summary: Stab Gene in the gut when Knifey suggests it.

steps.text: Turn in the 9-Torg bounty and finish talking to @npc{Gene} at home.
When Knifey says he wants to stab Gene and a melee prompt appears, stab Gene.
This is the only chance in the game.

achievements.summary: Defeat Douglas, the second bounty.

guide.context: Take the Douglas bounty before Krubis. That order gives you Sweezy for "Gunning For Your Job".

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Douglas}. Ignore the Grunts, because they die on the electrified floor.

achievements.summary: Obtain Sweezy.

steps.text: After you beat @enemy{Douglas} and collect his DNA, pick up @item{Sweezy} from Douglas's suit.

achievements.description: Use Sweezy to boss around the Office Moplets.
achievements.summary: Use Sweezy to give orders to the Office Moplets.

steps.text: Pick the Douglas bounty before the Krubis bounty. That gives you Sweezy.
Take Sweezy on the Krubis bounty. In the @loc{Administration Office}, equip Sweezy.
Talk to the Moplet receptionist Helen and choose "I'm the new boss".
Go through the doors on the left, walk to the desk and give your new Moplets any orders. The choice does not matter.
Talking to Helen without Sweezy equipped fails the dialogue and you cannot leave it.

achievements.summary: Defeat Krubis, the third bounty.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Krubis}. Slow him with Sweezy's @mechanic{Time Bubble} when he charges, and hit him with Knifey for bigger damage.

achievements.summary: Obtain Gus.

steps.text: After you beat @enemy{Krubis} and collect his DNA, escape the pit. @item{Gus} joins you there.

achievements.summary: Obtain the Jetpack.

steps.text: During the Meet Clugg section, sleep in your bed. You wake up wearing the bounty suit with the @item{Jetpack}.

achievements.summary: Obtain Creature.

steps.text: In the Skrendel Bros bounty, open the @loc{Weapons Lab} and find the experiment subject. This gives you @item{Creature}.

achievements.summary: Defeat the Skrendel Brothers.

steps.text: Fire Creature's critters at the brothers and focus on one brother at a time. Knifey hits do more damage if you time them.

achievements.summary: Obtain the Mag-Boots.

steps.text: In the Dr. Giblets bounty, after the crowd scene, grab the @item{Mag-Boots} during the objective "Find a Way Out of High on Life".

achievements.summary: Defeat Dr. Giblets.

steps.text: Open the door to @enemy{Dr. Giblets} on the rooftop. He falls and dies on his own.

achievements.summary: Pay your bill at Applebee's.

steps.text: Carry at least 34 pesos before you enter @loc{Space Applebee's} in the objective "Find Lizzie - Go to the Slums Applebee's".
After the meal with Kenny, pan down to the table and interact with the bill before you leave.
You cannot go back into the restaurant afterwards.

achievements.displayName: Spent 15 Hours At The Alien Strip Club
achievements.description: Spend 15 hours at the very real in-game alien strip club.
achievements.summary: Fight Nipulon until the game awards this achievement mid-fight as a taunt.

guide.context: The description mentions 15 hours at a strip club, but this is a joke and no waiting is needed.

steps.text: Reach and fight @enemy{Nipulon}. The achievement unlocks during the fight, with no time spent waiting.

achievements.summary: Defeat Nipulon, the sixth bounty.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Nipulon's Lounge} and fight @enemy{Nipulon}. Shoot the real Nipulon in purple armor in the falling sections, not the fakes in green armor.

achievements.summary: Obtain Lezduit.

steps.text: In Final Preparations, pick up @item{Lezduit}.

achievements.summary: Hear Suit-O say goodbye during the Garmantuous bounty.

steps.text: While you clear the G3 out of the road, Suit-O says a few words and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Sacrifice a Gatlian other than Kenny during the fight against Garmantuous.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice a gun other than Kenny in the Garmantuous fight.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Garmantuous}. Kenny then offers to detonate the bomb.
Switch to another gun and use that gun to detonate the bomb.
This is your only chance in the game.

achievements.description: Defeat Garmantuous and take down the G3 cartel.
achievements.summary: Defeat Garmantuous and take down the G3 cartel.

steps.text: Beat @enemy{Garmantuous} in the final bounty. Lezduit works well against him, and Knifey also works.

achievements.displayName: We're All Very Impressed, Trust Me
achievements.description: Juggle an enemy in the air with at least 5 shots.
achievements.summary: Land at least 5 shots on one enemy while it is airborne.

guide.context: If it does not unlock, reload the checkpoint or try again later in the game.

steps.text: Shoot an enemy while it is airborne until 5 shots have hit it. The 9-Torg bounty has good targets.

achievements.summary: Pop 20 Grunt eyeballs.

guide.context: You cannot die in this section, so it is a safe place to repeat.

steps.text: During the first street fight, aim at the eye of each @enemy{Grunt}. A correct kill makes the Grunt run around shooting until its eye pops and it falls.
Reload the checkpoint to repeat until 20 eyes are popped.

achievements.summary: Watch Globo become famous on the TV screens in Blim City.

guide.context: If Globo is not on the screens after Nipulon, finish the Garmantuous bounty and check the screens again.

steps.text: During the 9-Torg bounty, "Return Home", talk to @npc{Globo} and his friend left of your house. Exhaust all dialogue.
Before the third bounty, exhaust dialogue again. Buy the Drum (78 pesos) at @loc{Mr Keep's Pawn Shop}, at the back near the Gatlians shelf. Give it to Globo.
During Meet Clugg, before you buy the Jetpack, exhaust all dialogue with Globo again.
Before the fifth bounty, talk to Globo's friend and exhaust his dialogue.
Before you enter the Slums in "Find Lizzie", check the Slums Applebee's area. Globo's friend is gone and posters announce a TV appearance.
Before you turn in the sixth bounty, portal to @loc{Downtown} and go to @loc{Blorto's}. Watch Globo on the nearby TV screens.
Do not give Globo the Drum earlier than the third bounty.

achievements.displayName: We Paid For The Rights To Put A Whole Movie In Here
achievements.summary: Discover the movie theater.

steps.text: Buy the @item{Movie Theatre Warp Disc} for 3 warp crystals from @npc{Blorto} in @loc{Blim City}.
Use the disc in a blue warp signal area. @loc{Valley Bluff} in Zephyr Paradise is easiest.
Watch the movie for a couple of minutes.

achievements.description: Sit through the entirety of the really annoying countdown show on TV.
achievements.summary: Watch the whole TV advert with the countdown robot.

steps.text: At home after you turn in the 9-Torg bounty, wait for the advert where a robot talks about prizes and counts down.
If it does not play, quit the game and load your save again. Do not use "load last checkpoint".
Watch the advert to the end.

achievements.description: Discover Dr. Gurgula's hideout in the Human Haven.
achievements.summary: Reach Dr. Gurgula's hideout in the Human Haven.

steps.text: After the story, portal to @loc{Clugg's Office} in Nova Sanctus and take the purple card from the desk.
Portal to @loc{Human Haven}. Look up and Jetpack up the platforms to a locked door with a button.
Open the door and go in. Use Sweezy's @mechanic{Time Bubble} on the spinning fan, drop down the vent, and use it again on the next fan.
Continue down to the hideout.

achievements.description: Unlock and explore every collectible warp base.
achievements.summary: Buy, use and finish every warp disc from Blorto.

guide.context: Buy discs from @npc{Blorto} in the middle of @loc{Blim City} with warp crystals (31 total). Use each disc in a blue warp signal area such as @loc{Valley Bluff} or the Upper Valley of Zephyr Paradise. If you run short on crystals, kill the three G3 bases that warp in left of @loc{Laboratory Crossroads}. Each holds one.

collectibles.name: Cutie Town Warp Disc
collectibles.method: Stomp on all the buildings, then shoot the tiny alien.

collectibles.name: Movie Theatre Warp Disc
collectibles.method: Watch the movie for a couple of minutes.

collectibles.name: Skate Park Warp Disc
collectibles.method: Score 42,069 points in one minute. Run under the ramp with the red alien face and keep jumping through the hole in it. This gives a Luglox chest.

collectibles.name: Trolley Tracks Warp Disc
collectibles.method: Warp in with the disc and explore the Trolley Tracks area.

collectibles.name: Toilet Warp Disc
collectibles.method: Solve the pipe puzzle by connecting the pipes.

collectibles.name: Quiet Cottage Warp Disc
collectibles.method: Open the three Luglox chests inside the cottage.

achievements.description: Find and open every Luglox chest.
achievements.summary: Open every Luglox chest, 227 in total.

guide.context: Most areas are open after the story. Warp discs and cottage chests need warp crystals.

steps.text: Scan for the blue blip that shows a nearby Luglox. Opened chests leave a body, so you can see which are done.
Blim City: 15. Shanty Town (Slums): 26.
Zephyr Paradise: Deep Jungle 34, Upper Valley and Mine 32, Jungle Clearing and Skrendel Labs 28.
Port Terrene: Outskirts 16, Old Town 27, Dreg Town 36, Nipulon's lounge 8.
Five hidden chests: one reward from the Skate Park warp disc, three inside the Quiet Cottage warp disc cottage, and one on Gatlus at the base of the statue outside the house.
Chests stay opened when a warp disc area is reloaded, so do the Skate Park and Quiet Cottage rewards once.

achievements.description: Unlock every post in the Bounty Hunter forums.
achievements.summary: Open all the posts in the Suit OS Bounty Hunter forums.

guide.context: Do the leftovers after the story. Hunks come after the 4th wave at The GMS Schlooper Wreck, Jasons arrive on the roof of the second warp base in Lower Dreg Town, Snipers appear in Old Town, Mytes respawn near the cages in Mine Outskirts, and Greebles pop out near the hookbug ramp at The GMS Schlooper Wreck.

steps.text: Pause the game and open the far-right Suit OS tab to see the forums and what each post still needs.
Blim City Banter: discover every Downtown and Slums location, and find 6 Dr. Gurgula hints.

Gurgula hint places: Douglas' Office (poster by the spinning fan), Dr. Giblets' Lab (red table and the screen next door), Jonathan Skrendel's Office (button left of the Weapons Lab button), Nipulon's Office (screen behind the Luglox), Downtown (graffiti behind Blorto's under the Krust Lord sign).
Combat posts: melee kills 60, any-gun kills 480, armor pierced 480, Merks 120, Melee Merks 120, executions 60, Hunks 30, Jasons 60, Snipers 60, interactable kills 240.

Zephyr Paradise posts: Mytes 480, all Jungle, Mine and Skrendel Labs locations, and every vendor item bought. Hidden places: Spring Canyon, Upper Furgle Warren, Sideways Pass, Root Route, Sector C Elevator.
Port Terrene posts: Greebles 120, all Outskirts, Dreg Town and Old Town locations, and every vendor item bought. Hidden place: Unidentified Wreckage.
Kill counters keep their value when you reload a checkpoint, so you can repeat a fight to farm.

achievements.description: Collect every trading card in the game.
achievements.summary: Collect all 27 trading cards in the base game.

guide.context: 25 of the cards come from Luglox chests. The last two are for sale at @loc{Mr Keep's Pawn Shop} in Blim City.

collectibles.name: Milk-Drinker Mikey
collectibles.method: Open the Luglox in a container.

collectibles.name: Sweaty Sam
collectibles.method: Use Gus's disc on the hotwall to climb to the Luglox.

collectibles.name: R-Word Reece
collectibles.method: Open the Luglox at the end of the path.

collectibles.name: Muscular Matty
collectibles.method: Slow the fan with Sweezy's Time Bubble and enter behind it.

collectibles.name: Online Oliver
collectibles.method: Follow the hookbugs to the Luglox inside the wreck.

collectibles.name: Frasier From Frasier
collectibles.method: Zipline from the building opposite to reach the tower top.

collectibles.name: Dead Alec
collectibles.method: Find the Luglox inside one of the buildings.

collectibles.name: Drooling Julian
collectibles.method: From the Recruitment Center entrance, go left and lower the panels with Kenny's Glob Shot. The Luglox is on a ledge.

collectibles.name: Farting Fridley
collectibles.method: Slow the fan on the right of the portal with Sweezy's Time Bubble.

collectibles.name: The Adventure Begins
collectibles.method: Behind the red door near the Security Checkpoint. Switch the 5 terminals to the screen with the Luglox.

collectibles.name: I'll Be A Space Captain
collectibles.method: Behind the hut with the zipline activator button.

collectibles.name: Jazz Skabbit Works Alone
collectibles.method: On top of a container.

collectibles.name: Three-Way From Planet Hell!
collectibles.method: Under a ramp of the Clone Mulcher building.

collectibles.name: Brock Spliffy Attacks!
collectibles.method: Top of the rock formation. Use short Jetpack bursts to cross the gap.

collectibles.name: Abandoned by Flibby
collectibles.method: On a building as you cross the district.

collectibles.name: Return of the Ravenous Fangbeast
collectibles.method: On the roof of the Supply Station building.

collectibles.name: A Wedding Beneath the 2 Moons
collectibles.method: In front of the sludgefall on the left side.

collectibles.name: Who's That at the Door?
collectibles.method: Right of a sludge fall is a tunnel. Jetpack down into it.

collectibles.name: Don't Lose a Finger
collectibles.method: Left of the ramp up to Old Town. Use the zipline and the metal surface.

collectibles.name: Clone Remover
collectibles.method: On the Saloon roof behind a fan. Slow the fan with Sweezy's Time Bubble.

collectibles.name: Portal Lubricant
collectibles.method: From the hookbug go right instead of left and follow the path around.

collectibles.name: The Shwoggy
collectibles.method: On top of a tower. Reach it by zipline.

collectibles.name: Home & Hive Magazine
collectibles.method: Go right along the room edge to the curtained doorway. The Luglox is in the little room ahead.

collectibles.name: Grimple Gram
collectibles.method: From the portal climb the ledges and hotwall, then follow the metal surface to a hidden ledge.

collectibles.name: 12 Holiday Trunglefunk Classics
collectibles.method: Far left of the pipe puzzle across the gap. Slow the traffic with Sweezy's Time Bubble.

collectibles.name: The New "You"!
collectibles.method: Buy it for 568 pesos.

collectibles.name: Cup O'Pee
collectibles.method: Buy it for 2300 pesos.

achievements.description: Complete the game with Stan's product in your inventory.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with Stan's product in your inventory.

steps.text: After you buy the Jetpack at @loc{Mr Keep's}, turn left and walk to the giant blue alien statue in @loc{Blim City}.
Talk to @npc{Stan} and agree to buy his product. It is free and gives you a Gallon of Alien Cum.
Keep it in your inventory until the Garmantuous credits.
You can delay talking to Stan, but do it before the Garmantuous fight.

achievements.description: Collect all 9 trading cards on Peroxis and Muxxalon.
achievements.summary: Collect all 9 trading cards from Peroxis and Muxxalon.

guide.context: Cards come from Muxxalon packages and rewards. For Peroxosquash, turn on Full Auto Firing and raise Aim Assist Max Angle in the accessibility settings, and drop B.A.L.L.'s bumpers before the match starts.

collectibles.name: Barfazard
collectibles.method: Talk to the card-fan slug by the shop entrance. He gives you this one.

collectibles.name: Dungmancer
collectibles.method: Beat Slugstar's time in the first race. The time limit is generous.

collectibles.name: Flukey
collectibles.method: Score 2000 points in Peroxosquash.

collectibles.name: Humoranger
collectibles.method: Open the package in the container. Press the button, then get back before the forcefield returns.

collectibles.name: Pyrat
collectibles.method: Beat Slugstar's time in the race near the ranch.

collectibles.name: Ripsaur
collectibles.method: Answer the Riddle Master's three riddles. Any answers work.

collectibles.name: Squealbur
collectibles.method: Above the Turbine Room entrance. Use Knifey's upgrade on the goop ball and wake the hookbug with Creature.

collectibles.name: Tadtwo
collectibles.method: In a container on the wall. Open the membrane beside it with Knifey's upgrade.

collectibles.name: Zenicow
collectibles.method: Above goop in a cage. Use the hotwall to reach the button and Glob Shot the panels.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mux in Knifey's Package.

guide.context: Her health does not reset if you die.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Mux's Core} and fight @enemy{Mux}. Destroy the organ she leaves after each head phase.
In the pit phase, shoot the parasites on the walls for shields.
At the end, ride the goop pillar up and interact with Mux.

achievements.displayName: We Came, We Chainsaw, We Conquered
achievements.description: Kill a Bloat with Knifey's new upgrade.
achievements.summary: Kill a Bloat with Knifey's new upgrade.

steps.text: After you get Knifey's package, cut the purple membrane on the floor with Knifey.
Finish the first @enemy{Bloat} on the stairs with Knifey.

achievements.displayName: Bathe With A Giant Nude Alien
achievements.summary: Take a bath with Toxxo.

steps.text: During Knifey's Package at @npc{Toxxo}, jump into the toxic bath.
Stay in until the Relaxometer fills. Shoot the @enemy{parasites} for shield pickups. Sweezy works well.
You can climb out to recover at the 1/4 and 3/4 checkpoints.
Dying in the bath loses the achievement.

achievements.displayName: Fall In Love With A Parasite
achievements.description: Find a way to make love to the Parasite Passenger.
achievements.summary: Pick the correct dialogue lines with the Duffalo, using Sweezy or Creature, to romance the Parasite Passenger.

steps.text: After you defeat the poachers and return to the ranch in "Smuggle Yourself Into Muxxalon", interact with the Duffalo.

Use Sweezy or Creature. Pick these lines in order. Sweezy: "Don't you know who we are?", "No, I made up those words", "You're a gross little worm", "Too bad, that's all you get", "If we keep going it's gonna get too steamy", "They do actually".

Creature: "Sorry I'm distracted by how hot you are", "When's the last time you went on a date?", "What if we turned this into a date?", "Let's play truth or dare", "Dare", "(Lean in for a kiss)", "Would you like to go further?".
A wrong line loses the achievement.

achievements.description: Visit Cheeks and hang out until closing time.
achievements.summary: Complete every Cheeks task, without killing parasites or leaving, until closing time.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Cheeks} in Toxxo's Butt. Do not kill the parasites and do not leave.
Take a shot at the bar. Then jump on the bar and move around.
Choose a side by talking to the slug you want to back.
Stand by the slug who challenges you to a race and run around the bar.
Crouch next to the slug who wants to give you germs, then crouch next to Frasier.
Talk to the slug who wants to meet your guns. Switch to a new gun and interact with him.
Shoot him with any gun.

achievements.description: Visit every major Peroxian landmark and report back to the tour guide.
achievements.summary: Visit every major Peroxian landmark and report back to the tour guide.

steps.text: Talk to the tourism guide slug in @loc{Salt Lick City}. Take the four postcards.

Visit Sparkler's Grotto (cave left of the Bathers Isle landing), the Crashed Spaceship (seen from Salt Lick City's entrance), Hookbug Bay (head right leaving Salt Lick City toward Toxxo) and the French Spires (head left from Salt Lick City).
Return to the guide and give either answer. He sends you to Morris' Pond.
Visit @loc{Morris' Pond}, right of the Bathers Isle landing, then talk to the guide again.

achievements.summary: Open every scattered Muxxalon package, 58 in total.

steps.text: Outskirts and Salt Lick City: 18 packages. Salt Lick City #10 needs Slugstar's time beaten there, and #17 needs 2000 points in Peroxosquash.

Duffalo Ranch region: 21 packages across Bathers Isle, Sparkler's Grotto, Cheeks, the Bathing District, Underground Passage, Salt Range, the ranch and Poacher Territory. Bathers Isle #5 needs the long race near Toxxo, which needs Knifey's upgrade. Salt Range #13 needs the Riddle Master and #14 needs Slugstar's race near the ranch.
Muxxalon HQ: 19 packages in the Central Chamber, Turbine Room, Sorting Facility, Cargo Loading Wing and other rooms.
The HQ packages open only after the story brings you into Muxxalon HQ.

achievements.description: Kill 100 enemies with a fully charged ball shot.
achievements.summary: Kill 100 enemies with fully charged B.A.L.L. shots.

steps.text: Get B.A.L.L. by playing Peroxosquash, then hold the shot until it is fully charged before you fire.
At the @loc{French Spires}, portal to Outskirts and go straight past Salt Lick City. Mytes spawn in waves of 6, 6, 9, 12 and 10.
Reload the last checkpoint until Mytes come, and repeat until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.summary: Become the Riddle Master.

steps.text: In @loc{Salt Range}, go left from the Sam Schnott's Duffalo Ranch sign to the building behind Slugstar's third race. A slug stands outside.
Talk to the slug and answer all three riddles. Any answer works. Correct answers still count as wrong.
Take the Muxxalon package he gives. Then shoot him when he asks.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies with Harper's glob shot.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies with Harper's glob shot.

steps.text: Use the same @loc{French Spires} Mytes farm as the B.A.L.L. kills. Use only Harper's glob shot.

achievements.description: Grant the dying wish of a sick slug.
achievements.summary: Pick "Take All Our Money" for the dying slug in the Salt Lick City hospital.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Salt Lick City}, follow the path left past the top-hatted slug on a podium and climb the stairs to the hospital.
Talk to the slug on the bed four times. Pick "Take All Our Money".
Picking the other option kills the slug and you lose the achievement.
Talk to the slug again to get your money back.
